facts.fact: Orion X, whose team first took root in Botswana, offers its Uhuru African language model to users via WhatsApp, SMS, USSD and a web app, with a free tier and a USD 7 (P99) monthly Pro tier, per CEO Mthabisi Bokete and Chief AI Officer Kgengwenyane.
